title: OpenAI 948 Linux Root Paths - Patch and Verify the Path
content:
OpenAI ne 4 Nov 2026 ko ek post publish
kiya: A thousand fewer paths to root.
Title scary lagta hai, numbers aur bhi.
Unke autonomous pipeline ne Linux kernel
pe 948 LOCAL PRIVILEGE ESCALATION exploits
produce kiye.
Matlab unprivileged user se root tak ka rasta.

Ye numbers OpenAI ke apne post se hain.
Pipeline upcoming cyber model ke saath chala.
2,308 candidate findings.
1,724 reproduced.
948 LPE exploits.
End-to-end API cost $1,213,430.
Human researchers review karte hain before
reporting.
Sampled set mein 10 novel techniques bhi dikhe.

Pehle clear karo yeh kya NAHI hai.
Yeh public exploit dump nahi hai jisse koi
abhi attack kare.
OpenAI ke hisaab se humans review ke baad
reporting / patching path pe jaate hain.
Mere paas private exploit details nahi
hain, aur main share bhi nahi karunga.
Hum defense side pe focus karenge.

Defender move 1: Linux systems ASAP patch karo.
Kernel aur privilege boundary updates
delay mat karo.
Agar tum VPS, laptop, ya CI runners pe Linux chalate ho,
update cadence tight rakho.
Unpatched low-privilege account ko
well-resourced attacker ke liye
almost-root mat samjho - OpenAI ka tone
bhi yahi direction mein hai.

Defender move 2: DEFENSE IN DEPTH.
Sandbox. Isolation. Least privilege.
Ek process ko poora machine mat do.
Containers, VMs, separate service accounts
- jo bhi tumhare stack mein fit ho.
Agar ek agent ya tool compromise ho, blast
radius chhota hona chahiye.

Sabse important lesson agents ke liye.
OpenAI ne bataya: early run mein 200 mein se 20 exploits ne root kisi DOOSRE bug se liya, assigned bug se nahi.
Matlab result sahi dikhe, path galat ho sakta hai.
Apne agents mein sirf final answer mat trust karo.
VERIFY THE PATH to the result.
Kaunsa tool call hua, kaunsa file touch
hua, kaunsa command chala - log rakho.
Especially irreversible actions se pehle.

Mera take simple hai.
AI security research ab industrial scale
pe aa gaya hai - dollars aur volume dono
dikh rahe hain.
Attackers bhi yeh capability chase karenge.
Tumhara job: patch fast, isolate hard, aur
agent outputs ko path-check ke bina
production mein mat chodna.
Fear content nahi. Hygiene content.

Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
